questions.q: What does supplier registration allow a potential trading partner to do?
options: Immediately receive payment for any invoice
Automatically become Spend Authorized
Skip the need for any address or bank account
Submit their own company information directly, rather than having Brightfield's team enter it manually
questions.explain: Registration lets a prospective supplier self-submit information such as company details, tax ID, and addresses.

questions.q: What access does a registered but not-yet-accepted supplier typically have?
options: Restricted access — they can log in and participate in negotiations or surveys, but cannot be paid
Full access, identical to an approved supplier
No access of any kind until manually approved
Access only to the General Ledger
questions.explain: Registered-but-unaccepted suppliers have restricted access: able to engage in sourcing/qualification activity but not able to be paid.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of Supplier Qualification Management?
options: To merge duplicate supplier records
To screen prospective suppliers with surveys and scoring before they're trusted with real spend
To calculate invoice due dates
To mask bank account numbers
questions.explain: Qualification management distributes surveys, scores responses, and helps decide whether to accept a prospective supplier before they enter the Supplier Master.

questions.q: Why does qualification happen BEFORE a supplier is created as a full record, rather than after?
options: Because Oracle Fusion cannot delete supplier records
Because qualification can only run on existing invoices
To keep unqualified, fake, or unwanted suppliers out of the Supplier Master in the first place
Because registration is not possible after creation
questions.explain: Screening before creation avoids having to clean up the Supplier Master after letting in suppliers that shouldn't have been accepted.

questions.q: Does every new supplier have to go through formal registration and qualification?
options: No — a buyer can still manually create a supplier for a low-risk, one-off purchase
Yes, there is no other way to create a supplier
Only suppliers with a business classification require it
Only international suppliers require it
questions.explain: Formal registration and qualification exist for situations needing documented vetting; manual creation remains an option for low-risk cases.
